explanations.10: This makes the script exit immediately if any command fails, instead of continuing with broken data.
explanations.11: This makes the script treat undefined variables as errors, preventing typos in variable names from silently breaking things.
explanations.12: This makes the script exit if any command in a pipeline fails, not just the last one.
explanations.23: This extracts the API key from a .env file by finding the line that starts with 'ANYTHINGLLM_API_KEY=', taking the first match, splitting on the equals sign, and removing quotes.
explanations.25: This checks that the ANYTHINGLLM_API_KEY variable is set; if it's empty, the script stops and shows an error message telling you how to fix it.
explanations.31: This tries to reach an AnythingLLM server at each candidate URL with a 2-second timeout, silently checking if it responds to a ping.
explanations.37: This requires the ANYTHINGLLM_URL to be set; if the script couldn't find a running server, it stops and tells you.
explanations.48: This uses awk to parse a Markdown file and extract a specific key-value pair from the YAML frontmatter (the section between the dashes at the top).
explanations.51: This checks if the current line starts with the key name followed by a colon, which marks where the value begins.
explanations.52: This removes the key name and colon from the line, leaving just the value part.
explanations.53: This removes any double quotes from the beginning and end of the value.
explanations.71: This reads the state file line-by-line, splitting each line into three parts (hash, path, location) using a tab character as the separator.
explanations.85: This extracts just the hash part from the stored entry by splitting on a tab and keeping everything before it.
explanations.100: If the slug (a URL-friendly name) isn't defined in the frontmatter, it falls back to using the folder name instead.
explanations.116: This extracts the document location from the stored entry by removing everything before and including the first tab character.
explanations.119: The '|| true' at the end makes this command always succeed even if the deletion fails, so the script doesn't stop.
explanations.134: This extracts the 'location' field from the JSON response, or returns empty if that field doesn't exist.
explanations.149: This finds all index.md and index.mdx files, prints them with null terminators for safety, sorts them, and passes them to the while loop.
explanations.154: This reconstructs the storage format by splitting the combined hash-and-location back into separate parts: hash, file path, and location.
